**Leaf node logic (Tree.tsx, ~line 309):**
`const { testStatus } = getChangeDetectionStatus(statuses || {})` — only `testStatus` is destructured. The `changeStatus` return value is never used. A story leaf with only a `storybook/change-detection` status (e.g., `WithChangeDetectionOnly`) will have `testStatus = 'status-value:unknown'`, get `testIcon = null`, and render **no icon at all**. The PR description says "Rendered two independent StatusButton components per leaf node" but the implementation doesn't do this — there's a single test-only slot on leaves.

**Branch change-only slot layout (Tree.tsx, rendering section ~line 509+):**
When only `branchChangeIcon` exists (no `branchTestIcon`):
- First ternary: `branchChangeIcon && branchTestIcon` → false → renders `<StatusSlotPlaceholder />` in the LEFT slot
- Second ternary: `branchTestIcon` → false → renders the change button in the RIGHT slot

Result: `[placeholder] [change_button]` — the change icon ends up in the right/test position, creating inconsistent slot semantics. When both exist, change is correctly on the left.

**Invalid `type` attribute on `<svg>` (~line 445):**
`<svg key="icon" viewBox="0 0 6 6" width="6" height="6" type="dot">` — `type` is not a valid attribute for `<svg>` elements. This is a copy-paste artifact from the `UseSymbol` prop.

**`@ts-expect-error` in `getGroupDualStatus` (status.tsx ~lines 168 and 194):**
Two suppressions hiding potential type issues, against project rules.

**Dead `groupStatus` in NodeProps:** Still declared in the interface but no longer destructured in `Node`. Passes through silently.

**Duplicate filtering logic:** `getChangeDetectionStatus` in Tree.tsx duplicates the same `typeId === CHANGE_DETECTION_STATUS_TYPE_ID` filter in `getGroupDualStatus` in status.tsx. Utility belongs co-located with its sibling.

**`BranchWithChangeDetectionPriority` detached render override:** Story is built by `makeDualSlotStory` (which sets `render`), then that `render` is immediately replaced by a detached assignment. Confusing pattern.

**Missing play functions on new stories:** Stories aren't exercised programmatically, so expanded/icon states won't be captured in visual regression.

**Misplaced unit test:** The `'branch/group combined priority: error beats new'` test is only asserting `getMostCriticalStatusValue` behavior and should live in the `getHighestStatus` block.
